name: elicitation-lab-real
description: Elicitation Lab — model-drafted MCP elicitation/create forms. Runs on Val Town (main.http.ts) or on any common Node server via `npm start` (server.ts).

scripts.check: deno check main.http.ts server.ts lab/model.ts lab/bindings.ts backend/*.ts scripts/*.ts
scripts.verify: deno run --allow-env --allow-read --allow-import --allow-net scripts/verify-page.ts && deno run --allow-env --allow-read --allow-import --allow-net scripts/verify-render.ts && deno run --allow-env --allow-read --allow-import --allow-net scripts/check-render.ts
